cite.locator: p. 5, Line 16, "Enter the total of all qualified expenses incurred in 2025 for the care of your qualifying person(s)"; p. 1, Dependent Care Benefits, "The fair market value of care in a daycare facility provided or sponsored by your employer"; p. 3, Columns (a) and (b), "If you were covered by your employer's dependent care plan and your employer furnished the care (either at your workplace or by hiring a care provider), enter your employer's name in column (a)"

project.form: Form 2441, line 16, with employer-furnished care
project.remedy: Your employer furnished care whose value is among your dependent care benefits, and the expenses you entered are less than your benefits. The instructions do not say whether the value of the care your employer furnished is a qualified expense incurred for line 16, and that decides how much of your benefits is excluded; this tool does not figure that case.

cite.locator: p. 8, Payments to Relatives or Dependents, "However, don't count any amounts you pay to"

project.form: Care provider who is an ineligible related person (Form 2441, line 1)
project.remedy: Payments to a person you or your spouse can claim as a dependent, your child under 19, a person who was your spouse during 2025, or the parent of your qualifying child under 13 do not count, and such a provider may not be listed. Remove that provider and the payments to them, or prepare the form outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 22, Social security number, "You must enter each dependent’s social security number (SSN)" and "If your dependent child was born and died in 2025 and you do not have an SSN for the child, enter “Died” on row (3) of the Dependents section and include a copy of the child’s birth certificate, death certificate, or hospital records"; p. 14, Head of Household, "The dependents you claim are those you list by name and SSN ... in the Dependents section on Form 1040 or 1040-SR"

project.form: Dependent without an SSN, ITIN or ATIN (Form 1040, Dependents, row (3))
project.remedy: Each dependent must be listed with an SSN (or ITIN or ATIN) issued on or before the due date of your return. A dependent child who was born and died in 2025 without an SSN, entered as "Died" on row (3) with a copy of the birth certificate, death certificate or hospital records, is outside this tool.
